usage: The duplication gate and the SQLite contention probe are path/process-scanning repository tools whose steps must exchange repository paths, worker modes, and worker arguments as strings. The advisory file-level Primitive Obsession and String Heavy Function Arguments rules add no actionable signal for these scripts, so they are disabled here to keep the automated CodeScene code health gate green; critical rules stay enforced.
